name: tradingcalc-mcp
description: 32 deterministic crypto futures tools: trade planning (pnl, breakeven, exit_target, scenario, dca_entry, scale_out), risk (liquidation, position_sizing, max_leverage, risk_reward), funding & carry (funding_cost, funding_arb, compound_funding, funding_breakeven, carry_trade), market structure (open_analysis, session_structure, value_migration, breakout_acceptance), primitives (average_entry, hedge_ratio), integrated decision (pre_trade_check), chain-agnostic on-chain (token_risk_check, swap_price_impact, bonding_curve on Solana; market_cap_comparison and wallet_flag_check on Solana + 5 EVM chains), prediction markets on Kalshi's crypto-price category (odds_converter, market_implied_odds, prediction_market_edge). Formulas normalized across 16 exchanges, linear and inverse contracts. Every response signed with ECDSA P-256. Not AI estimates, exact numbers your trading bot can trust.
author: TradingCalc <s@tradingcalc.io>
